meta.source: Model/Fawley Court - Financial Model v16.xlsx, Capex tab
meta.note: The schedule is a first-principles estimate built by a non-quantity-surveyor on what the data room contains, named public rates, and stated allowances where nothing else exists. There is no forward cost plan, no measured survey, no ground investigation and no MEP survey anywhere in the room.

Rate: Greenway 'Demolition, Stripout & Temporary Works' GBP 156/m2 taken at 50% - a soft and FF&E strip only, the fabric being sound (Principal site inspection, 17 Aug 2026). A full FF&E strip-out is required regardless of fabric quality (Principal sit

lines.desc: Residual asbestos - survey, opening-up finds, licensed removal
lines.basis: Quantity: Main House GIFA 3,855 m2 (Greenway Associates, Historic Cost Estimate Rev 0, 20 May 2026, p.8 (Q2 2026 rates, Main House 3,855 m2 GIFA)). Rate: Greenway priced asbestos removal at GBP 52/m2 as part of works already reflected in the building; 29% of that rate carried as a residual for opening-up finds. No Main House asbestos survey, register or clearance certificate exists in the data roo

EPR annotates 'was 13' against the 17-key schedule: 1 new key on the first floor

lines.desc: Structural alteration - lower ground and ground floor (kitchen, BOH, goods route)
lines.basis: Quantity: basement 1,448 m2 + ground 881 m2 (Greenway Associates, Historic Cost Estimate Rev 0, 20 May 2026, p.8 (Q2 2026 rates, Main House 3,855 m2 GIFA)). Rate: Greenway LG/GF basebuild GBP 1,727 / GBP 1,362 per m2, area-weighted GBP 1,589, at 16% - localised alteration for the relocated kitchen, back-of-house and a goods route. EPR annotates the basement service run 'Too far' and the kitchen 'V

lines.desc: Second passenger / service lift, new shaft through Grade I fabric
lines.basis: Quantity: one. The Main House has a single lift (EPR Key Plans p.7, key area 12) serving a basement kitchen, ground-floor public rooms and 17 keys over two floors, with no service lift shown. Rate: allowance for a new shaft formed through Grade I fabric, including listed building consent, structural opening formation and making good.

lines.desc: Envelope and roof - residual repairs and opening-up
lines.basis: Quantity: Main House GIFA 3,855 m2. Rate: Greenway envelope and roof (external repairs GBP 169 + windows/doors GBP 233 + roof GBP 311 = GBP 713/m2) at 10%, the works being recorded as done and the fabric reported strong (Principal site inspection, 17 Aug 2026). No current roof or window condition survey for the Main House exists in the room.

lines.basis: Quantity: 3,855 m2 GIFA. Rate: Greenway 'MEP Adaptations Allowance' GBP 1,450/m2 at 50%. Plant and back-of-house were reported strong (Principal site inspection, 17 Aug 2026), but hotel loads, resilience, building management, guest technology and life-safety distribution are new. lines.basis: Quantity: four risers assumed for a two-floor, 17-key distribution across a house of this plan depth; no riser strategy exists in any document. Rate: structural opening formation, fire stopping, listed building consent and making good per riser.

lines.desc: Comfort cooling - external condenser plant, acoustic enclosure, heritage screening
lines.basis: Discreet condenser siting on a Grade I building within a Grade II* registered park and conservation area, with acoustic enclosure and screening. A consent line as much as a cost line.

lines.desc: Comfort cooling - electrical supply, distribution, controls integration
lines.basis: Additional incoming capacity, distribution boards, and integration of cooling controls into the building management system.

lines.desc: Fire suppression, detection, emergency lighting and signage
lines.basis: No fire strategy, fire risk assessment, building control record or fire systems documentation of any kind is in the data room. Rate: allowance for sprinkler or mist suppression, detection, emergency lighting and signage across the whole house.

Rate: Greenway 1F/2F fitout GBP 4,500/m2 at 70% - that figure priced a private-house restoration already executed; this is the hotel guestroom overlay (bathrooms, joinery, AV, lighting, finishes) on restored fabric. Equivalent to GBP 228,800 per key excluding FF&E

lines.desc: Public areas - restaurant, bar, lounge, reception, private dining
lines.basis: Quantity: restaurant 122 + lounge 100 + bar 115 (EPR Proposed Area Schedule, sheet 'Area Schedule ' A7:C9) + basement FOH private dining/events 175 (EPR Proposed Area Schedule, sheet 'Area Schedule ' A5:C5) = 512 m2. lines.desc: Main production kitchen - relocation and extension
lines.basis: Quantity: 380 m2 assumed for a production kitchen, cold rooms, wash-up and stores serving 60 keys and two restaurants; no kitchen area is stated anywhere in the room and no ceiling heights are given for any building. EPR's own annotations read 'Very small kitchen - Relocate or extend to 1' and 'Too far' (Key Plans p.8). Rate: allowance including extract routed through Grade I fabric.

lines.desc: Back of house - housekeeping, stores, staff facility, goods-in, laundry
lines.basis: Quantity: 620 m2 of the 1,448 m2 basement (which includes tunnels) assumed as working back-of-house. Main House BOH is not quantified anywhere: the labels exist on EPR Key Plans p.8 but carry no areas, and EPR annotates housekeeping 'Too small HK'. Total scheduled estate BOH is 9,612 sq ft across 60 keys, about 160 sq ft per key including staff accommodation.

lines.desc: Public area and F&B FF&E - internal
lines.basis: Quantity: 512 m2 of internal public and F&B area. Rate: area-based equivalent of the public-space FF&E benchmark of USD 5,000-15,000 per key on top of guestroom FF&E (2026 hospitality procurement guidance).

lines.desc: Terrace and external FF&E, Main House
lines.basis: Quantity: 328 m2 of scheduled terrace. No external FF&E line exists anywhere in the data room.

lines.desc: Art, antiques and decorative works
lines.basis: Greenway excluded Art & Sculpture entirely (p.6). No FF&E inventory, chattels list or schedule of what a sale would include exists in the room; the house is presented furnished and the freeholder is a Jersey company. Allowance for the operator-standard art and decorative programme, not for acquiring the vendor's chattels.

excluded.note: Greenway's own estimate shows 20% on its £45.79m. Recoverability depends on the SPV and the operating structure and has not been ruled. Anything irrecoverable is additive to every figure here.

Every rate is Q2/Q3 2026. The BCIS all-in tender price index was running at 3.2% a year in June 2026, and the programme is fourteen quarters from T+1 — roughly £8–12m on this base, inside the contingency only by accident.
Align's annotation reads nine bedrooms and Savills describes a 65-key hotel; the EPR schedule prints 60. Nothing is consented, no application has been submitted and no design exists.
Roughly £1.07m net at the extension rate, and a consent question before it is a cost question: the extension it would enlarge is itself unconsented.
The art and antiques line prices an operator-standard programme, not the existing contents. No inventory or chattels list exists anywhere in the room.
Finance and pre-opening losses are the model's job, not the budget's; they appear in the cost to open.
